**Finding: compliant (MFN).**

The Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation burdening Northwind. The single MFN-type clause, § 7.6 (p0031), runs in our favour — Brightline warrants our Fees will be "no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer for comparable volumes and terms," including a like-for-like comparison qualifier.

I checked § 7 (Fees), § 4 (Order Forms), and § 30 (General) in full and ran targeted searches for best-terms, match-the-offer, disclosure, preferred-supplier, and first-refusal mechanics; nothing requires us to extend Vendor terms given to third parties. This satisfies the preferred position, so no redline was proposed and the Vendor-granted MFN is left intact.
